title: console: a member refused the Setup app still gets /apps/setup/OBJECT routes rendered inside another app's shell — the alias spelling skips the app verdict #27507 added
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWJDYbbtH6dhJNoboN

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷（用户可见），具名落点 + 复现（reach: 界面，普通成员打开 `/_console/apps/setup/sys_user`，实测两次）
业务理由: 普通成员点到旧链接 `/apps/setup/system/users`（清单项自己列的旧地址，书签和文档里也有）会被转到 `/apps/setup/sys_user`，结果看到的是 Showcase 的顶栏和侧栏套着系统用户列表，地址栏却是 setup，像是自己进了管理后台；而规范写法 `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user` 正确显示「无权访问此应用」。#27507 修过 `/apps/setup/system/*` 这一类，别名拼写的对象路由漏了。服务端读权限本身按设计放行（sys_user_org_members 策略），这是界面判定不一致，不是越权。
动手的读者: domain:ui 席，`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 的应用判定：别名（`setup`）拼写的对象路由也要走与规范 id 相同的「拒绝进入该应用」判定，遵守其「NEVER render a different app」注释。
查重: `apps/setup alias object route member` 48 命中、`No settings registered member` 258（均含已关）；最近邻 #27507（同类的 system/* 路由，已关 completed），没有覆盖对象路由别名的开卡。

QA-source: #28981 · platform-core.home-admin-cluster-links · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
For a plain member (no Setup app access):
- `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user` and `/_console/apps/setup/system/settings` show "You don't have access to this app … Back to home" (correct, #27507);
- `/_console/apps/setup/sys_user`, `/apps/setup/sys_organization` and `/apps/setup/showcase_task` render the object list inside the **Showcase** app's header and sidebar, under a `/apps/setup/…` URL;
- the legacy `/_console/apps/setup/system/users` redirects there, so the member reaches it from a documented URL.

Same class under an app the member can open: `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/system/settings` shows the settings hub with "No settings registered. Plugins can register settings manifests via the SettingsService." (the server returns 0 manifests to a member), #27507's first symptom on a route its fix did not cover.

Server side is by design: `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user` → 200 under the `sys_user_org_members` policy; `GET /api/v1/meta/app/setup` → 403. Presentation only.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), stock showcase boot from a scratch copy, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; mint a plain member (invite then sign-up, or admin create-user then change-password); form sign-in as that member.
2. Open `/_console/apps/setup/sys_user`.
3. **Expected:** the "You don't have access to this app" page, as for `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user`.
4. **Actual:** the Showcase shell with the sys_user list (4 users). Reproduced twice on fresh browser contexts.
